## Course Principle {.statement-slide}

> Write code that another actuary can understand, reproduce, and trust.

## What You Will Learn {.cards-slide}

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.metric-card .icon-card}
**Work with data**

Import and validate actuarial datasets.
:::

::: {.metric-card .icon-card}
**Analyse**

Create measures and summaries.
:::

::: {.metric-card .icon-card}
**Visualise**

Build charts that explain results.
:::

::: {.metric-card .icon-card}
**Report**

Communicate reproducible findings.
:::
:::

## Close {.statement-slide}

The goal is not to memorise R functions.

The goal is to solve actuarial problems in a way another actuary can understand, reproduce, and trust.
